listeningQuestions.audio: We must protect our cultural heritage.
opts: 我们必须保护我们的文化遗产。
我们必须建造一座新水坝。
我们应该卖掉这些老房子。

listeningQuestions.audio: The engineers moved the temple to a safe place.
opts: 工程师们把庙宇搬到了安全的地方。

listeningQuestions.audio: Fifty countries donated money to the project.
opts: 五十个国家为这个项目捐了款。
委员会拒绝了这个方案。

listeningQuestions.audio: Researchers take digital photos of the cave paintings.
opts: 研究人员在墙上重新作画。
他们把壁画搬进了博物馆。
研究人员为洞窟壁画拍摄数码照片。

listeningQuestions.audio: The Great Wall belongs to the whole world.
Protecting the past is everyone's duty.
opts: 保护过去是每个人的责任。
只有政府才能保护遗产。

quizQuestions.q: We must ____ our cultural heritage for future generations.
The government planned to build a ____ across the Nile.
Fifty countries ____ money to save the temples.
We must keep a ____ between progress and protection.
The archaeologist ____ found the relics became famous.
The temples ____ were moved are now safe from the water.
Dunhuang is the city ____ the Mogao Caves are found.
She is the writer ____ book about heritage won a prize.

opts: 一个委员会成立起来以减少损害。
quizQuestions.audio: A committee was set up to limit the damage.

opts: 这些传统可能很快消失。
这些传统被卖到了海外。
quizQuestions.audio: These traditions may disappear very soon.

reading.passage: In the 1950s, a new dam on the Nile threatened many ancient temples. Instead of letting them drown, the world worked together: experts made a plan, fifty countries gave money, and engineers moved the temples to higher ground. The rescue took twenty years and became a model of international teamwork.
reading.passageCn: 20世纪50年代,尼罗河上的一座新水坝威胁着许多古庙。世界没有任其被淹,而是齐心协力:专家制定方案,五十个国家出钱,工程师把庙宇搬到高地。这场拯救历时二十年,成为国际合作的典范。

opts: A new dam on the Nile.
They were moved to higher ground.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a person or group who works to protect cultural heritage. Say what they do and why it matters. Use at least one relative clause.
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍一个保护文化遗产的人或团体:他们做什么、为什么重要。至少用一个定语从句。

lines.text: Excuse me, could you tell me about this temple?
lines.cn: 打扰一下,您能给我讲讲这座庙吗?

lines.text: Of course. It was built hundreds of years ago and is an important heritage site.
lines.cn: 当然。它建于数百年前,是一处重要的遗产地。

lines.text: How can we help protect places like this?
lines.cn: 我们能怎样帮助保护这样的地方呢?

lines.text: Never touch the relics, and tell others why they matter.
lines.cn: 绝不触碰文物,并告诉别人它们为何重要。
